title: ofac / sanctions / drc | Regulatory Guidance | Treasury Sanctions Former Democratic Republic of the Congo P...
summary: The U.S. Treasury's OFAC sanctioned former DRC President Joseph Kabila for materially supporting M23 rebels and the Congo River Alliance (AFC), both U.S.-designated armed groups, as part of efforts to enforce the U.S.-brokered Washington Accords signed December 4, 2025. Kabila is accused of providing financial support to AFC, encouraging military defections, and seeking to install a candidate opposed to the current DRC government. The action targets continued instability in eastern DRC where M23 has captured major provincial capitals including Goma and Bukavu.
